<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₁₃H₁₈N₂O₂ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 234.1368 Da, error ≈ 20 ppm). This fits the required “CxHyOzX” style, where X represents the additional element(s) (here N). 

Thus the molecular formula of the sample compound is: C13H18N2O2.
